result.topic_en: A short German note completing a geometric construction argument: if the third sine differs in sign from the other two, the constructed point lies in the unsuitable segments of both circles σ and γ; dated 29 July 1852.
result.transcription:
Segmente des Kreises $\sigma$
Weicht hingegen der dritte Sinus rücksichtlich des Zeichens
von den beiden andern ab, so liegt der durch die Construction
gefundene Punkt in beiden Kreisen $\sigma$ und $\gamma$ im ungeeigneten
Segmenten
1852 Jul 29.

methods.what: Sign criterion for the constructed point: if the third sine has a sign different from the other two, the constructed point lies in the unsuitable segments of both circles
